name: Jellyfin Now Playing
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Shows what's playing on your Jellyfin server: poster art, title, and playback progress

versions.notes: Bitmap fonts and documentation. A .bdf face exists at exactly one pixel size, so picking 5x7.bdf or 4x6.bdf at any other size raised inside FreeType and fell back to PIL's default -- a much smaller font -- with only a log warning; twelve of the thirteen offered sizes were affected for each. They now load at their own size instead. cozette.bdf is dropped from both font menus: the core ships no such file, so it could never load at any size (#387). The README gains real rendered screenshots, documents progress_bar_match_text and all eight customization settings that were previously summarised in one line, and states which fonts work at which sizes.

Progress bar now matches the widest of the title and subtitle instead of spanning the whole text area, so a short episode name no longer leaves a bar stretched across a wide panel — and the blank remainder can be reclaimed in Vegas scroll mode. Disable with progress_bar_match_text.

Initial release: polls the Jellyfin /Sessions API and shows the active session's poster (series poster for TV episodes), scrolling title and subtitle, a paused indicator, and a progress bar that moves smoothly between polls. Includes username and content-type filters, a Nothing Playing screen, and on-panel setup/error messages on all four panel sizes.
